verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents an interactive Playground where users can run Search queries without an API key, and it publishes an API reference page (sonar-post) showing the response schema, backed by a live OpenAPI spec. However, nothing shows that the API reference itself is interactive or that its examples can be run in place. The Playground is documented only for Search. Missing for 10: evidence of try-it/runnable examples inside the API reference, interactive coverage beyond the Search endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: try Perplexity Search in the interactive Playground
